# ===================================================================== # Schedule the auto-validation of the selected transfers (valijas). # The validation datetime is "now", EXCEPT on Friday (local time): then it # is Sunday 08:00, so the night run validates it on Sunday night, before # Monday's delivery (wanted, Isabella 23/11/2026). # Phase 1 checks every transfer, phase 2 writes: nothing is written unless # all of them are valid. # ===================================================================== TZ_LOCAL = timezone('Europe/Madrid') TZ_UTC = timezone('UTC') DEFER_WEEKDAYS = [4] # 0=Mon ... 4=Fri TARGET_WEEKDAY = 6 # Sunday TARGET_HOUR = 8 ALLOWED_STATES = ['assigned', 'confirmed', 'waiting'] TRACKED_TYPES = ['lot', 'serial'] COUNTRY = 'ES' # valijas only exist in Spain DATE_FMT = '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M' now_utc = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0) now_local = TZ_UTC.localize(now_utc).astimezone(TZ_LOCAL) is_deferred = now_local.weekday() in DEFER_WEEKDAYS if is_deferred: days_ahead = (TARGET_WEEKDAY - now_local.weekday() + 7) % 7 or 7 target_day = now_local + datetime.timedelta(days=days_ahead) target_naive = datetime.datetime(target_day.year, target_day.month, target_day.day, TARGET_HOUR, 0, 0) validation_date = TZ_LOCAL.localize(target_naive).astimezone(TZ_UTC).replace(tzinfo=None) else: validation_date = now_utc validation_label = TZ_UTC.localize(validation_date).astimezone(TZ_LOCAL).strftime(DATE_FMT) # ---- Phase 1: check everything, write nothing errors = [] for picking in records: if (picking.company_id.country_id.code or '') != COUNTRY: errors.append('%s: las valijas solo existen en España (compañía %s).' % (picking.name, picking.company_id.name)) continue if picking.x_studio_validation_date: errors.append('%s: ya está programada (%s).' % ( picking.name, TZ_UTC.localize(picking.x_studio_validation_date).astimezone(TZ_LOCAL).strftime(DATE_FMT))) continue if picking.state not in ALLOWED_STATES: errors.append("%s: en estado '%s' no se puede programar." % (picking.name, picking.state)) continue useful = False missing_lots = [] for move in picking.move_ids_without_package: if float_compare(move.quantity, 0.0, precision_rounding=move.product_uom.rounding) <= 0: continue useful = True if move.product_id.tracking in TRACKED_TYPES and not move.move_line_ids.filtered_domain(['|', ('lot_id', '!=', False), ('lot_name', '!=', False)]): missing_lots.append(move.product_id.display_name) if not useful: errors.append('%s: todas las líneas están a 0, no hay nada preparado.' % picking.name) continue if missing_lots: errors.append('%s: falta lote o serie en %s.' % (picking.name, ', '.join(sorted(set(missing_lots))))) if errors: raise UserError('No se ha programado nada. Revisa:\n\n• ' + '\n• '.join(errors)) # ---- Phase 2: align demand to what is prepared, drop empty lines, schedule, note for picking in records: empty = env['stock.move'] for move in picking.move_ids_without_package: rounding = move.product_uom.rounding if float_compare(move.quantity, 0.0, precision_rounding=rounding) == 0: empty |= move elif float_compare(move.quantity, move.product_uom_qty, precision_rounding=rounding) != 0: move.write({'product_uom_qty': move.quantity}) if empty: empty._action_cancel() empty.unlink() picking.write({ 'x_studio_scheduled': True, 'x_studio_locked': True, 'x_studio_validation_date': validation_date, }) note = ('📌 Valija programada. Se validará sola esta noche con lo que está preparado, sin crear pendiente.
' 'Fecha de autovalidación: %s' % validation_label) if is_deferred: note += '
Programada en viernes: se valida el domingo por la noche, antes de la entrega del lunes.' picking.sudo().message_post(body=note, body_is_html=True, subtype_xmlid='mail.mt_note')

# ===================================================================== # Validate scheduled valijas with what is prepared (reserved), without # backorder: each line is reduced to its prepared quantity, lines with # nothing prepared are removed, and the transfer is validated. # ===================================================================== MANUAL = bool(env.context.get('gn_manual')) STATES = ['assigned', 'confirmed', 'waiting'] MAX_PICKINGS = 30 # per night run LOOKBACK_DAYS = 30 # only transfers created in the last 30 days SAVEPOINT = 'gn_valija'
now = datetime.datetime.utcnow() Picking = env['stock.picking'].sudo()
if MANUAL: pickings = records.sudo().filtered_domain([ ('x_studio_scheduled', '=', True), ('x_studio_locked', '=', True), ('state', 'in', STATES)]) if not pickings: raise UserError('Ninguna de las transferencias seleccionadas está programada (botón «Programar valija»).') else: pickings = Picking.search([ ('x_studio_scheduled', '=', True), ('x_studio_locked', '=', True), ('state', 'in', STATES), ('x_studio_validation_date', '!=', False), ('x_studio_validation_date', '<=', now), ('create_date', '>=', now - datetime.timedelta(days=LOOKBACK_DAYS)), ], order='x_studio_validation_date asc, create_date asc, id asc', limit=MAX_PICKINGS)
done = [] failed = [] for picking in pickings: name = picking.name env.cr.execute('SAVEPOINT ' + SAVEPOINT) try: if picking.state in ('confirmed', 'waiting'): picking.action_assign() empty = env['stock.move'].sudo() prepared = False for move in picking.move_ids: rounding = move.product_uom.rounding if float_compare(move.quantity, 0.0, precision_rounding=rounding) <= 0: empty |= move continue prepared = True if float_compare(move.quantity, move.product_uom_qty, precision_rounding=rounding) != 0: move.write({'product_uom_qty': move.quantity}) if not prepared: raise UserError('no hay nada preparado (ninguna cantidad reservada)') if empty: empty._action_cancel() empty.unlink() res = picking.button_validate() if isinstance(res, dict) and res.get('res_model'): raise UserError('Odoo pide confirmar «%s»' % res.get('res_model')) if picking.state != 'done': raise UserError("no ha quedado hecha (estado '%s')" % picking.state) picking.write({'x_studio_scheduled': False, 'x_studio_locked': False}) env.cr.execute('RELEASE SAVEPOINT ' + SAVEPOINT) done.append(name) except Exception as error: env.cr.execute('ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT ' + SAVEPOINT) env.invalidate_all() failed.append('%s: %s' % (name, error)) log('Valija %s not validated: %s' % (name, error), level='error') Picking.browse(picking.id).message_post( body='⚠️ Esta valija no se ha podido validar sola: %s. Revísala y valídala a mano (lo revisa Data).' % error, subtype_xmlid='mail.mt_note')
if done or failed: log('Valijas: %s validated, %s failed' % (len(done), len(failed)), level='info') if MANUAL: action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': 'Valijas', 'message': ('Validadas: %s.' % (', '.join(done) or 'ninguna')) + ((' No validadas: ' + '; '.join(failed)) if failed else ''), 'type': 'warning' if failed else 'success', 'sticky': bool(failed), 'next': {'type': 'ir.actions.act_window_close'}, }, }

# Validate the selected scheduled valijas now (same rules as the night run) action = env.ref('gn_valijas.action_validate').with_context( gn_manual=True, active_model='stock.picking', active_ids=records.ids).run()
